package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for custom_recovery_logic_repeated_across_handlers: Repeated recover or panic-to-response logic inside handlers instead of centralized recovery middleware.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func OrderHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	defer func() {
		if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
			log.Printf("panic recovered in OrderHandler: %v", rec)
			http.Error(w, "internal server error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
	}()
	fmt.Fprint(w, "order processed")
}

func PaymentHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	defer func() {
		if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
			log.Printf("panic recovered in PaymentHandler: %v", rec)
			http.Error(w, "internal server error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
	}()
	fmt.Fprint(w, "payment processed")
}
